errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly groups several years into the 0-500 million range. The bars for 2003 (approx. 800), 2010 (approx. 700), 2011 (approx. 800), 2012 (approx. 850), and 2014 (approx. 800) are all visibly well above 500.

errors.evidence: The description claims an increase over the period 2005-2007, but the data shows a slight decrease from 2005 (approx. 3,600) to 2006 (approx. 3,400) before the large increase in 2007. This is an oversimplification of the trend.
